subject.title: refactor: store gateway restart recovery in SQLite

question: Does the project want to land this database-first restart-recovery cutover with permanent delivery receipts and a durable 45-attempt terminal ceiling once the exact-head gates are clean?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and proven, but the persisted migration and terminal delivery-retention semantics are compatibility choices with upgrade and message-delivery consequences that require owner acceptance.

options.title: Refresh and land
options.body: Rebase, resolve the exact-head failures, and land the cutover with the existing migration and durable receipt semantics.

options.title: Narrow retention semantics
options.body: Keep the SQLite migration but revise permanent receipt or terminal retry behavior before landing if indefinite retention or non-revival is not desired.

options.title: Pause the cutover
options.body: Leave the JSON-to-SQLite migration unmerged until maintainers choose a different upgrade or delivery-ownership contract.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land
recommendation.body: Rebase, resolve the exact-head failures, and land the cutover with the existing migration and durable receipt semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle owns the current branch design, is assigned to the PR, and has addressed the prior restart-recovery findings across the relevant modules.
